subject: Deal hygiene stand-up: urgent SKU/Amount fixes for Q4 forecast
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme-acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deal hygiene stand-up: urgent SKU/Amount fixes for Q4 forecast

Team —

Quick one: finance asked for a tightened ARR forecast before close of play Friday. Looking at ACME-125 the CRM fields that are blocking a clean commit are: amount (two lines have blank amounts), product/SKU (mapped to "Other" for several rows), and a handful of stale next steps & probabilities. I attached a CSV export with the raw rows I pulled (acme_oppty_export.csv) and a proposed SKU map (sku_mapping_v2.xlsx).

Immediate asks (please):
- Lauren: audit the three mid-stage line items and populate amount + correct SKU mapping where the customer has already confirmed product (see row ids 14, 17, 22 in the CSV).
- Marissa: review probability and close date for the two largest line items (ARR > $25k) and update next step to a specific ask (e.g., "PO submission" or "Legal review").
- Jordan: if you can run a quick de-dupe on the opportunity lines and confirm there are no phantom SKUs, that would help tidy the numbers.

CC'd procurement from Acme — if anything below is inaccurate on your side (pricing or sku), please flag in reply so we don't flip values and create a restatement.

Timeline: aim to have updates in HubSpot by EOD Thursday so finance can ingest on Friday morning.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124

Attachments: acme_oppty_export.csv (CSV, 54 rows), sku_mapping_v2.xlsx (Excel, mapping table)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deal hygiene stand-up: urgent SKU/Amount fixes for Q4 forecast

Thanks Ben — I'm on it. Quick update after a first pass:
- I found the blank amounts: two are pre-sales services that weren't moved to line items correctly (rows 14 and 22). I'm re-entering the agreed ARR numbers and will tag them with SKU=RDW-PRO-ANNUAL per the mapping file.
- Row 17 appears to be a duplicate of row 9 with a slightly different close date. I'll merge into row 9 and keep the larger amount, mark the duplicate as "Closed - Won" to avoid double counting.

I'll push changes to HubSpot now and follow up here with the exact record ids I edited.

Appreciate the heads-up. Two quick notes from my side after looking at the export:
1) The two largest line items Ben referenced are showing a 60% probability in HubSpot but customer has verbally committed to the POC and budget approval next week — I recommend bumping those to 85% only if you can confirm PO timing with procurement.
2) There are three line items mapped to SKU=RDW-ENT-OTHER that we haven't reconciled to specific modules. Before changing SKU values, can Lauren flag which rows have written confirmation of product? I don't want to change SKU mapping purely on our best guess.

Jordan — if you can run the de-dupe and also export the hubspot "last_activity" for the opportunity so we can justify probability changes to finance, that would be ideal.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Enterprise GTM
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Great work — thanks, team. Quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 
- Lauren: updated rows 9, 14, 22; merged duplicate row 17 into 9. Edited amounts and applied SKU per sku_mapping_v2.xlsx. (Lauren to paste updated HubSpot record ids in reply.)
- Marissa: please confirm whether to move the two large line items to 85% probability once procurement confirms PO timing.
- Jordan: please deliver the de-duped export and last_activity column by 11:00 PDT tomorrow so finance can accept the probability bumps.

I've uploaded the cleaned CSV to the shared drive and attached a short change log (redwood_commit_change_list.pdf). Finance is looped in; they'll run the ingestion Friday morning. Acme procurement — if you can confirm expected PO week (MM/DD) that would let us lock ARR for Q4.
